# Macro Software Solution LLC

> Macro Software Solution builds custom software, SaaS products, websites, mobile apps and reliable IT infrastructure, and offers AI optimization and answer engine optimization (AEO). All work is custom-quoted; package pricing will be published soon.

## Services
- SaaS development: platforms built to evolve
- Cloud & integration: connect tools and infrastructure
- Custom software: built around your workflows
- IT infrastructure: keep operations resilient
- Web development and website maintenance
- Mobile development
- Digital marketing
- AI optimization & answer engine optimization (AEO): structured data, FAQ schema, answer-ready content, AI automation

## Ways to work together
- Career Platform: launch-ready career/hiring platform with 1:1 onboarding; client runs their own marketing
- Hire Macro: end-to-end design and development by the Macro team
- Modifications & upgrades: changes, fixes and integrations for existing systems
